PLAN "12-Week Upper-Body Focused Programme for Subacromial Impingement (Recreational Climber, Office Worker)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper-body strength with shoulder-friendly loading; pain-free range only; progressions from control to loaded to sport-specific climber demands"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundational Stability & Pain-Free Strength":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10..12 rpe 6.5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Stability Progression A":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          overhead_tricep_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Grip & Scapular Control":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          high_row (use cable_row variant) 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_fly 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 60 seconds
          shoulder_discussion_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Technique & Endurance":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          frontal_plane_shoulder_prehab 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          pec_stretch 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Load-Introduction with Climber Focus":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..10 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          cable_row 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Shoulder-friendly Strength Continuation":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x8..10 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          scapular_retraction_hold 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Technique for Climbing Alignment":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          band_pull_apart 3x15..20 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracicMobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Volume Push-Pull Balance":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x40 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          back_stretch 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Climber-Specific Strength Builder":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x8..10 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Load Progression & Stability":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x8..10 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          cable_row 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Power-ish Reps with Control":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_mobility 60 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Deload & Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 5.5 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x10..12 rpe 5.5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 5.5 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 120 seconds

EXERCISE VOCABULARY used (canonical):
push_up, pull_up, chin_up, dip, bench_press, incline_press, decline_press, dumbbell_press, shoulder_press, overhead_press, military_press, arnold_press, dumbbell_row, barbell_row, bent_over_row, cable_row, seated_row, lat_pulldown, cable_pulldown, bicep_curl, hammer_curl, concentration_curl, preacher_curl, tricep_dip, tricep_extension, tricep_pushdown, skull_crusher, face_pull, rear_delt_fly, lateral_raise, front_raise, dumbbell_fly, cable_fly, chest_fly, pec_deck, shrug, upright_row, squat, front_squat, goblet_squat, sumo_squat, split_squat, lunge, walking_lunge, reverse_lunge, lateral_lunge, deadlift, romanian_deadlift, sumo_deadlift, trap_bar_deadlift, leg_press, hack_squat, leg_curl, leg_extension, calf_raise, seated_calf_raise, standing_calf_raise, glute_bridge, hip_thrust, step_up, box_jump, jump_squat, hip_abduction, hip_adduction, good_morning, plank, side_plank, plank_up, crunch, bicycle_crunch, reverse_crunch, sit_up, v_up, russian_twist, wood_chop, leg_raise, hanging_leg_raise, lying_leg_raise, mountain_climber, dead_bug, bird_dog, ab_wheel, ab_rollout, hollow_hold, hollow_rock, toe_touch, pallof_press, superman, back_extension, jumping_jack, jump_rope, high_knees, butt_kicks, burpee, squat_jump, tuck_jump, arm_circles, leg_swings, hip_circles, ankle_circles, jog_in_place, marching, jumping_lunge, box_step, skater_jump, bear_crawl, crab_walk, inchworm, hamstring_stretch, quad_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, calf_stretch, achilles_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, tricep_stretch, lat_stretch, back_stretch, spinal_twist, neck_stretch, neck_roll, butterfly_stretch, frog_stretch, pigeon_pose, child_pose, cat_cow, forward_fold, standing_forward_fold, figure_four_stretch, wrist_circles, ankle_rolls, turkish_getup, clean, clean_and_press, snatch, kettlebell_swing, thrusters, wall_ball, farmers_walk, suitcase_carry, battle_ropes, rowing

CARDIO MODALITIES used (allowed):
running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking

Notes for client:
- All loading respects pain-free range; overhead loading avoided unless cleared by clinician.
- Focus on scapular control, rotator cuff activation, and mobility throughout.
- Progression via increasing sets/reps within the RPE targets and adding light load only when pain-free.
